drawer-1440-light-en.drawerText: How this is countedTokensEverything readCounted from 19 September.Members are attributed by launch chain.Claude context compaction is not counted.Claude and Codex transcripts are read; Copilot and OpenClaw report no tokens.Each model response counts once, however many times a transcript copies it.The total adds fresh input, cache reads, cache writes and output.
